headline: Spider-Verse 3 and Daredevil: Born Again headline 2027
post:
Superhero fans have plenty of exciting projects to look forward to over the next few years. According to /Film, the 2027 release schedule features eight movies and TV shows across the Marvel universe. Big titles on the way include the animated sequel "Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse" and the third season of "Daredevil: Born Again". 

Viewers can also expect new animated adventures like "Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man" Season 2 and "X-Men '97" Season 3. Meanwhile, the dark animated world of "Marvel Zombies" will expand with a special focused on the Winter Soldier. Younger viewers will also get new seasons and series on Disney Jr., keeping the fun going for all ages. 🛡️

Which of these 2027 projects are you most excited to watch?

headline: VisionQuest: how it compares to WandaVision
post:
The MCU series VisionQuest brings back favorites Paul Bettany as Vision and James Spader as Ultron for a compelling story about identity and humanity. While it is a clever and visually stunning show, it sometimes struggles with a lack of focus compared to WandaVision, which kept its story tightly centered on Wanda Maximoff's grief and magical sitcom hijinks.

headline: X-Men #94 Hits Heritage Auction Block
post:
Remember when the X-Men comics went through five years of reprints due to low sales? Chris Claremont's X-Men #94 totally changed that and brought the series back to life, paving the way for a massive 16-year revival. Now, a graded copy of this legendary issue is up for auction at Heritage.

This issue shook up the roster by introducing new members like Storm, Nightcrawler, and Colossus on their very first proper mission. Would you add this vintage piece to your collection?

#Marvel #XMen #Comics
original_title: This X-Men Comic Ended Five Years of Reprints, But It Also Changed the Team Forever

headline: Eight DC Heroes Who Could Wield Green Lantern Rings
post:
Ever wonder how other DC characters would fare with the ultimate weapon of the Guardians? According to Screen Rant, a recent feature spotlights eight heroes who possess the mental resilience, focus, and traits to become incredible Green Lanterns.

The list includes heavy hitters and street-level icons alike. For instance, Batman has previously shown his tactical prowess with the ring, while Diana of Themyscira boasts the leadership and bravery needed to guide the entire Corps. Other surprising candidates like John Constantine, the Flash, Blue Beetle, Raven, Mister Miracle, and Superman all display the extraordinary willpower required to master the ring and unlock a brand new layer of their potential. 🟢✨

headline: The Edge wrote a secret Elf sequel
post:
Did you know that U2 guitarist The Edge reportedly wrote an entire screenplay for a sequel to the 2003 holiday comedy Elf? According to original cast member Andy Richter, a producer was once asked to meet with him about the finished script, though the project never actually moved forward.

Of course, The Edge is also well known for co-writing the music and lyrics for the Broadway musical Spider-Man: Turn Off the Dark. 🎸

Would you have wanted to see this unmade Christmas sequel?
